lean.statement:
{Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    (D : Lp ℝ 2 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 μ) (hD : D.IsPositive) :
    let ι : Lp ℝ 2 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℂ 2 μ := Complex.ofRealCLM.compLpL 2 μ
    let R : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 μ := Complex.reCLM.compLpL 2 μ
    let Q : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 μ := Complex.imCLM.compLpL 2 μ
    let C : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℂ 2 μ := Complex.conjCLE.toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 μ
    (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 μ, ‖ι u‖ = ‖u‖) ∧
    (∀ g : Lp ℂ 2 μ, C g = g ↔ ∃ u : Lp ℝ 2 μ, ι u = g) ∧
    ∃ Dc : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ,
      Dc.IsPositive ∧
      (∀ g : Lp ℂ 2 μ, Dc g = ι (D (R g)) + Complex.I • ι (D (Q g))) ∧
      (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 μ, Dc (ι u) = ι (D u)) ∧
      (∀ g : Lp ℂ 2 μ, C (Dc g) = Dc (C g))
approved_definition_context: Lp with exponent 2 denotes AE equivalence classes of measurable square-integrable functions over the displayed measure. Its real/complex Hilbert structure is the integral inner product. No finiteness or probability property of the measure is assumed.

compLpL lifts the displayed bounded scalar continuous linear map to the same quotient function spaces; ofReal, re, im and conj act pointwise almost everywhere. The conjugation map is real linear and is not operator adjoint.

D.IsPositive means the bounded real operator is selfadjoint and its quadratic form is nonnegative. Endomorphism multiplication denotes composition. Norm preservation and the full conjugation-fixed range are conclusions.
